Findings.Finding: Native message dispatcher: if AppInterface+4752 is nonnegative, returns true without a dialog. Otherwise enumerates processes and may terminate exact-name WaitTitleProject.exe; calls the audio wrapper and sets GX suspension; sends synchronous WM_APP+1 with messageID and a stack int* result, waits if untouched, then clears pause/suspend. ID1 and6 true results invoke managed ExitApplication; ID5 true and ID7 unconditionally store256 to AppInterface+4752. Other IDs have no shutdown action here. No ID range check or timeout.

ActivationContract: No production activation is proposed. Existing BaseSimpleForm and the CLR must already own their UI thread and native AppInterface/window.
ShowEndMessageBox requires a valid owner and initialized AppInterface getter globals. It mutates shared hook/caption/termination state and may create an unjoined progress thread.
AnyMessage requires ID0..7 even though its body does not check this. WM_APP+1 requires same-process writable int* LPARAM for the synchronous handler. It is not an external process control protocol.
The native dispatcher is not a neutral dialog API: it has process termination, pause/suspend and shutdown effects. No Trainer call or Windows message is implemented.
English dialogue fallback does not translate KH2Form controls or supply missing private developer assemblies. Language menu callbacks persist a restart setting only.
